This analysis counts the number of `order_items` (item grain) with a 'Complete' status for each catalogue product (catalogue grain). The population is restricted to the executor-authorized product scope. No date filter was applied in q1; historical coverage was not audited. 

Based on the results [q1], there are no authorized products with zero 'Complete' items; all authorized products in the dataset have at least one completed item.

### Limitations
* This analysis did not measure the volume of items in other statuses (such as 'Cancelled' or 'Returned').
* It did not measure actual revenue, historical discounts, or net profit.
